plugin.name: Nebius Token Factory
plugin.description: Nebius Token Factory's models for the agent, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds Nebius Token Factory to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from Nebius Token Factory, so new models show up by themselves.
